name: svc.mirror

parameters.query:
SELECT t.id::text AS task_id, a.name AS agent, t.title, t.state,
       COALESCE(t.thread,'') AS thread,
       to_char(t.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created,
       COALESCE(to_char(t.due_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),'') AS due,
       COALESCE(to_char(t.completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),'') AS completed,
       COALESCE(LEFT(m.body,120),'') AS you_said
FROM tasks t
JOIN agents a ON a.id = t.agent_id
LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.id = t.source_message_id
WHERE t.state IN ('todo','in_progress','blocked')
   OR t.completed_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
ORDER BY CASE t.state WHEN 'blocked' THEN 0 WHEN 'in_progress' THEN 1
                      WHEN 'todo' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, t.created_at;

notes: Postgres -> readable Google Sheet. Called by svc.board on every state change, never scheduled: sub-workflow runs do not consume an n8n Cloud execution, so this is free and always current. Sheet needs a header row whose first column is task_id.
